newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Credibanco to set $50 mln, 3-yr bond Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Credibanco to set $50 mln, 3-yr bond Wednesday.

text.p: Brazilian retail bank Credibanco said it will issue a $50 million, three-year Eurobond on Wednesday via lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
"This will price at between 180 and 190 basis points over U.S. Treasuries," said Luciana Nunes, a sales manager at Credibanco.
Nunes said she hoped the issue would benefit by Tuesday's strong rebound in U.S. Treasury and Brady bond markets following the release of lower-than-expected U.S. consumer price inflation.
Credibanco has four other Eurobond issues outstanding, three of which come due this year, Nunes said.
Brazilian retail bank Itau issued a $100 million three-year bond last week which priced at 169 basis points over U.S. Treasuries. Traders said most of that deal has been placed.
